additional_info.subject: ID0477612-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S6 170003725] The charging station is not delivering full power CRM:02681001421
additional_info.body:
Dear Lennart,
Thank you for contacting eMobility Support.
Following your report, we have checked the charging session in the given timestamp, and we will explain what happened.
In the following screenshot you are able to see that during the pre-charge phase the charger was able to deliver the maximum power of 360kw. This is a measure tool to see if the charger is able to reach the maximum 360kw.
In the following screenshot you are able to see that during the charging session the charger was able to deliver the power that the car was asking, nothing more and nothing less.
In the following screenshot you are able to see that the charging session stopped, because the car didn`t request more power from the charger. The charger is required to follow the requests of the car.
This shows that the charger is able to deliver the maximum power of 360kw, but the car didn`t request this from the charger. The charging sessions of the charger happens in curves, which is good for the longevity of the battery of the car.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Please provide us with feedback, to be able to close the ticket.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: ID0477612-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S6 170003725] The charging station is not delivering full power CRM:02681001421
additional_info.body:
Dear Lennart,
Thank you for your update, we understand the query.
To explain this the best possible.
This charger has 4 group converters, in total 9 converters with each 40kw to provide. This indeed makes a maximum power of 360kw.
If it was the case that one converter was faulty, this would mean the charger would only be able to provide 320kw, which is not the case.
A power delivery of 331kw, means all converters are working, and this just has to do with the request from the cars.
The Sicharge D, is designed to regulate with the cars request, and to contribute to the longevity of the battery of the charger.
We hope to have informed you enough.
Thank you.
Kind regards,
Priscilla van Wettum

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0477612-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / S6 170003725] The charging station is not delivering full power CRM:03209000221
additional_info.body:
Guten Tag,
könnten Sie einmal prüfen auf welche maximale Leistung der Charger eingestellt ist? Wir hatten erst vermutet das es am Lastmanagement von Siemens liegt und haben nun auf unser internes vom Backend gewechselt, leider wird weiterhin nur mit ca. 330KW geladen. Uns ist bewusst das in den Logs steht das z.B. der Charger 418A anbietet, das Fahrzeug aber nur 416A nachfragt. An jeder anderen Ladestation außer von unseren Ladepark lädt das Fahrzeug aber schneller.
Wir benötigen für diesen Fall unbedingt eine Lösung.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
#gerneperdu
